conclusion: the tree-dump RPCs are registered in a profile build but carry no tree, because the diagnostics that back them are compiled out outside debug mode. The channel that does carry the observable is the platform accessibility hierarchy: running uiautomator attaches a UiAutomation, which is an assistive technology as far as the platform is concerned, so Flutter starts producing semantics and the strings become readable. The VM service is still needed to confirm the app is up and to hold the isolate, but it is not the read path

conclusion: two containers cannot share the lane SDK through :Z, because each relabels it exclusively and steals it from the other. A campaign must therefore never run a probe while a build holds the SDK. Mounting read-only with --security-opt label=disable removes the contention without relabelling anything another agent is using
